# Methodological Assessment

This folder contains evaluations of the methodological feasibility of clinical scoring systems used for healthcare quality indicators. It documents assessments of risk stratification tools such as P-POSSUM, APACHE, Surgical Apgar Score, and Charlson Score, specifically addressing whether they are too complex for routine practical use, how they might inadvertently exclude certain risk patients, and the historical lookback periods required for accurate comorbidity calculations.

## Pages

- [[methodological-assessment|Methodological Assessment]] — Evaluates the practical applicability, exclusion biases, and data retrieval requirements of clinical scoring tools like P-POSSUM, APACHE, Surgical Apgar Score, and Charlson Score for quality indicators.
